title: Store a text value
summary: Bash: Store a text value. Use a different name.
introduction: A variable assignment has no spaces around equals. Dollar-name reads the value.
learningObjectives: Store a text value with Bash

blocks.text: Use a terminal with Bash. Save each example as lesson.sh and run bash lesson.sh. These practice scripts do not delete or change files.
The assignment stores text under name. The quoted expansion keeps it as one value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Quote variable expansions so spaces stay inside one value.
